item.description: On the Monday before the Penn State outdoor hockey game, I was going through our basement cedar closet, looking for the best extreme cold weather coat. item.title: No. 1 Penn State Wrestling Takes Down No. 2 Ohio State 36-5 to Clinch Big Ten Regular Season Title
item.description: No. 1 Penn State wrestling (14-0, 8-0) won nine of 10 bouts against No. 2 Ohio State (17-1, 7-1) to run away with a 36-5 victory on Friday night before a program-record crowd of 16,006 in the Bryce Jordan Center. The win secured the Nittany Lions' 12th Big Ten regular season title in 17 seasons under head coach Cael Sanderson and sixth in a row. item.title: No. 6 Penn State Men’s Hockey Drops Crucial Road Series to No. 2 Michigan
item.description: Penn State’s Big Ten tour continued this weekend with a pair of games against No. 2 Michigan at Yost Ice Arena. The Nittany Lions battled through regulation and overtime before falling in the shootout Friday night, then dropped the second game 6-3 to close out the series Saturday, slimming the team’s chances of a regular season conference title with just one point in Ann Arbor.
